aries: First sign of the Western zodiac (late March to April), a fire sign
libra: The scales, the only sign that isn't a living thing (late September to October)
sagittarius: The archer, a centaur (late November to December)
capricorn: The sign of the December solstice (late December to January), an earth sign
pisces: Two fish, the last Western sign (late February to March)
chinese-rat: First animal of the Chinese zodiac, who won the race by riding on a back
chinese-ox: Second Chinese zodiac animal, hard-working and strong
chinese-tiger: Third Chinese zodiac animal, the striped big cat
chinese-rabbit: Fourth Chinese zodiac animal; in Vietnam it's a cat
chinese-dragon: Fifth Chinese zodiac animal, the only mythical one
chinese-horse: Seventh Chinese zodiac animal, a galloping one
chinese-goat: Eighth Chinese zodiac animal, a woolly grazer
chinese-monkey: Ninth Chinese zodiac animal, clever and playful
chinese-rooster: Tenth Chinese zodiac animal, the only bird
chinese-pig: Twelfth and last Chinese zodiac animal
